q: Clinic ke timings kya hain? What are your opening hours?
a: Clinic Peer se Hafta khula hai. Subah 10 baje se dopahar 1 baje tak, aur shaam 4:30 baje se raat 8 baje tak. Itwaar ko band rehta hai.

q: Fees kitni hain? How much does it cost? Cleaning filling root canal price
a: Fees ilaaj ke hisaab se mukhtalif hoti hain, aur clinic mu'ayena ke baad batata hai. Is liye main koi qeemat nahi bata sakta.

q: Clinic ka address kya hai? Where are you located?
a: Multan Dental Clinic, Multan Cantt, Gujar Khadda, Hameed Flour Mill ke saamne, Multan.

q: Doctor kaun hain? Which dentist will I see?
a: Clinic mein Dr. Arshad Mehmood (BDS) dentist hain.

q: Appointment cancel ya reschedule kaise karein? Cancellation
a: Booking ID aur booking wala phone number bata dein, appointment yahin cancel ho jati hai. Naya waqt chahiye to cancel ke baad nayi booking kar lein.

q: Emergency mein kya karein? Severe pain or swelling
a: Shadeed dard, sujan ya khoon na ruke to foran kisi qareebi dental clinic ya hospital se rujoo karein. Main chat par diagnosis nahi kar sakta.
